transcribed: 2026-09-17. 2016-01-07 to 2018-02-15: each table's text read from the text layer of the issue's PDF in a browser, the page text copied to disk and checked against the browser's copy by hash. 2018-02-22 to 2018-08-02: each image read at magnification, and the same tables' PDF text layer agrees with that reading on all 231 cells. The PDF URLs were found by trying the file names of two PDFs found by search; each PDF names its own issue date in a Week Ending line
